subject: Following a task
body: What does "Follow task" actually do? I followed a few tasks but I'm not sure I get anything different from before.
Where's the setting to make a project private so only invited people see it?

subject: Moving a whole section
body: Is it possible to move an entire section, with all its tasks, to a different project in one go? Moving 40 tasks one at a time isn't fun.
Best way to track a recurring weekly meeting's action items? New task each week, or one task with subtasks?

subject: Board vs list
body: Newbie question: can the same project be viewed as both a board and a list, or do I need to choose one when creating it?

subject: Reporting basics
body: Our manager wants a weekly count of tasks completed per person. Is there a built-in report for that, or should I build a dashboard? Where would I start?
please add subtasks of subtasks

subject: Feature request: task timers in mobile
body: Please add time tracking to the mobile app. Our technicians log time on site and have to remember to enter it on the web later, which means a lot of guesswork.

subject: Request: CSV import for time entries
body: Could you add a way to import time entries from CSV? We're migrating from Harvest and have 2 years of time data we'd like to keep with the tasks.
Would love a way to star or favourite tasks, like bookmarks. Projects can be favourited, tasks can't.

subject: Suggestion: templates marketplace
body: It would be great to have a gallery of templates shared by other teams (event planning, product launches, hiring). We spend a lot of time building structures that surely others have built already.

subject: Feature: client-facing progress page
body: Could you add a simple public progress page per project, showing a percentage and milestones, that we can share with clients without giving them a guest login? Something like a status page, but for a project.
Request: when a task is overdue, turn the whole card red on the board, not just the date text. Easier to scan.

subject: Feature request - multiple assignees
body: Please allow more than one assignee per task. We pair on a lot of work, and right now we either duplicate tasks or pick one person, which messes up workload reports.

subject: Request for Linux desktop app
body: Is there any chance of a Linux desktop app? Half our dev team is on Ubuntu and uses the web version, which works but lacks the desktop notifications and offline mode.
Could the calendar view show tasks as multi-day bars (start to due date), instead of only on the due date?

subject: Feature idea: automatic follow-ups
body: An automation to send a reminder to the assignee if a task hasn't been updated in X days would be super helpful. We have tasks that go quiet for weeks.

subject: Request: Markdown support
body: Please support Markdown in task descriptions and comments. Our developers keep typing backticks and asterisks out of habit, and they show up literally.
feature request: export dashboard as PDF. for board meetings

subject: Request: guest limits per project
body: We'd like to limit how many guests can be invited to each project, so project managers can't add unlimited clients. An admin setting for this would help our governance.

subject: Feature request + praise
body: First, the new timeline view is excellent, thank you. Feature request: could we see the critical path highlighted on the timeline? That would make it a real alternative to MS Project for us.

subject: Resource planning
body: Please consider adding capacity planning, where you set each person's weekly hours and see who's over or under-allocated across all projects. We currently do this in a spreadsheet outside the app, which is fragile and always out of date.
Can you add an "out of office" status that automatically reassigns or flags my tasks while I'm away?

subject: Request: better permissions for custom fields
body: Some of our custom fields (like "Budget") should only be editable by managers. Could you add per-field permissions? Right now anyone with edit access can change the budget.
great app 👍

subject: Feedback on new navigation
body: The new left navigation is much better than the old one. Finding projects is quicker. Nice work to whoever designed it.

subject: Too many popups
body: Every time I log in there's a new popup announcing a feature, a survey, or a tip. It's getting in the way. Please tone it down. Not a bug, just feedback.
Your pricing page is confusing. Took me 20 minutes to understand what's included in each plan. Just feedback.

subject: Support was excellent
body: I wanted to thank Rosa from your support team. She stayed on chat with me for over an hour to sort out our migration issue and followed up the next day. That's rare these days.

subject: Mixed feelings after 2 years
body:
Hello,

After two years with your product, I want to share some honest feedback. The core task management is great, and our team of 25 is genuinely more organised because of it.

But a few things have got worse over time. The app feels heavier and slower than it used to. Many of the new features seem aimed at large enterprises rather than teams like ours. And support replies now take days instead of hours.

We'll renew this year, but I'm keeping an eye on alternatives, which I never did before. I hope this is useful.

Best,
Marcus Oyelaran
The onboarding emails are too frequent. 7 emails in the first week is a lot.

subject: Mobile app is great now
body: Just a note that the latest mobile app update is a huge improvement. It's fast and it finally feels like the web app. Our field team is actually using it now.

subject: Feedback on AI features
body: The AI task suggestions are hit and miss. Sometimes brilliant, sometimes suggesting tasks that make no sense for our project. It'd be nice if it explained why it's suggesting something. Overall a promising start.
Honestly disappointed. Used to love this product, now it's cluttered and slow. Not asking for anything, just venting.

subject: Feedback from an accessibility perspective
body: I'm colour-blind, and the red/green status colours are hard for me to tell apart. The new icons next to statuses help a lot, thank you. Would love an option for colour-blind-friendly palettes someday.

subject: Feedback: great for small teams
body: We're a 3-person startup, and your free plan has been perfect for us. Just wanted to say thanks. When we grow, we'll happily pay.
The help centre articles are out of date. Half the screenshots show the old interface. Makes it hard to follow.

subject: Feedback on release notes
body: Could you make release notes more detailed? "Bug fixes and improvements" doesn't tell us whether the issue we reported was fixed. We end up testing everything ourselves.

subject: Customer since 2017
body: Just a short note from a long-time customer: I've tried four competitors over the years and always came back to you. Keep the simplicity. Please don't become bloated. Thanks for a tool I use every single day.
The sound effect when completing a task is delightful. Small things matter. Thanks!

subject: Feedback + question about roadmap
body: Overall very happy with the product. Our team's main wish is better reporting. Is there a public roadmap where we can see what's coming, and maybe vote on features?

subject: Survey feedback
body: Replying to your NPS survey: 6/10. The product is solid, but the price increase and slower support have made me less likely to recommend it. Hope that's useful.
love the new dark mode!! finally. thank you
found an xss in the task title field, how do i report

subject: Open redirect in login
body: The login page accepts a redirect_to parameter that isn't validated, so https://ourapp.com/login?redirect_to=https://evil.example sends users to an external site after login. That could be used for phishing. Reporting privately.

subject: API returns other users' data
body: When I call GET /v2/users/{id} with an ID from another organisation, I get their full profile (name, email, avatar). I believe I shouldn't have access to users outside my org. Tested with my own two test accounts in different orgs.
Your password reset tokens are only 6 digits and don't seem to expire for 24 hours. Brute-forceable. Do you have a security contact?

subject: Vulnerability disclosure: file download
body: I found that attachment download URLs are signed but the signature doesn't include the expiry, so a leaked URL works forever. I haven't used this beyond my own test files. Please let me know how you'd like me to share the details.

subject: Security issue in Zapier integration
body: The Zapier integration exposes an API key in the URL of webhook requests it sends, which means it ends up in Zapier's logs and any proxy logs. The key has full account access. This seems like a design flaw worth fixing.
Session tokens don't get invalidated when a user changes their password. Old sessions stay logged in. Found during our internal pentest.

subject: Report: guest can see private project names
body: A guest account in our workspace can see the names of all private projects in the search results, even though they can't open them. Project names like "Layoffs Q3 planning" are sensitive. We think this is a security bug.

subject: Responsible disclosure: SSRF
body: The "import from URL" feature for attachments lets the server fetch arbitrary URLs, including internal addresses like http://169.254.169.254/, which could expose cloud metadata credentials. I stopped testing as soon as I confirmed the behaviour. Please contact me for details.
CORS on your API allows any origin with credentials. That means any website a logged-in user visits can read their data via the API. Pretty serious. Where should I send the PoC?

subject: Bug bounty scope
body: Before I start testing: is your mobile app in scope for your bug bounty? And are third-party integrations in scope? I want to stay within your rules.

subject: Weak password policy
body: Your signup allows passwords like "password1" and "12345678". For a product holding business data, that's a weak policy. Consider checking against breached-password lists and requiring a minimum strength.
Exported CSV files are vulnerable to CSV injection: a task title starting with =HYPERLINK(...) becomes a live formula when opened in Excel. Suggest escaping leading =, +, -, @.

subject: Security: invite links reusable
body: Workspace invite links can be used by anyone, any number of times, and never expire. One of our invite links was posted publicly by mistake, and three strangers joined before we noticed. This should be fixed at the product level.

subject: Reporting a vulnerability - PGP?
body: I'd like to report a vulnerability affecting authentication. Given its severity, I'd prefer to send details encrypted. Do you have a PGP key or a secure submission form?
Your iOS app stores the auth token in plain text in UserDefaults. Anyone with a device backup can extract it. Should use the Keychain.

subject: Clickjacking on settings page
body: The account settings page can be framed by another site (no X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors). An attacker could trick users into clicking "Disable 2FA". I've confirmed it with a simple test page.

subject: Exposed .git directory
body: https://docs.ourapp.com/.git/ is publicly accessible and appears to expose your documentation site's git history, possibly including configuration files. You may want to block it.
Rate limiting on login is per-IP only, so credential stuffing through rotating proxies is trivial. Recommend per-account limits.

subject: Vulnerability + DPA request
body: Our security team found that audit logs can be deleted by workspace admins, which undermines their purpose. We think they should be immutable. We'd also like your DPA for our records. Org ID 81044.

subject: Hardcoded key in Android app
body: Decompiling your Android app (v5.4.2) reveals what looks like a hardcoded third-party analytics API key with write access. It might be worth rotating it and moving it server-side.
i think i got hacked. strange tasks in my account

subject: Unknown login from abroad
body: I got an email about a login from Kazakhstan an hour ago. That wasn't me. I've changed my password. Please check whether anything was accessed and whether any sessions are still active. Email: eva.lindstrom@spray.se

subject: Admin account compromised
body: Our admin's account was compromised through a phishing email. The attacker invited 4 external users and gave them admin rights before we noticed. We've removed them. Please help us check what they accessed and whether any data was exported. Org ID 30291.
Someone changed my 2FA phone number and now I can't log in. I didn't do that. Help!! My email: j.mendes@sapo.pt

subject: Suspicious API tokens
body: We found three API tokens in our admin account that nobody remembers creating, one made at 4am on a Sunday. Please revoke them and tell us what they were used for. acct_ap7713

subject: Attacker posting in our projects
body: Someone is posting spam comments with links in our projects, using the account of one of our designers. She's on holiday and says she hasn't logged in. We've changed her password, but the comments keep coming. Workspace: halcyon-design.ourapp.com
My email was changed on my account without me. Can't reset password because it goes to the new email. Original: ines.ferreira@outlook.pt

subject: Data exported by unknown user
body: Our audit log shows a full workspace export yesterday by a user account that belongs to an intern who left 2 months ago. We thought we'd removed him. How is he still able to log in? Please lock the account and tell us exactly what was exported. Org ID 50218.

subject: Compromised account + billing
body: My account was hacked. The attacker changed my name and upgraded my plan to Enterprise, which charged my card $600. I've got back in and changed my password. Please refund the charge, revert the plan, and check for anything else they changed. acct_hk2201
Logged in and saw my projects renamed to gibberish and several deleted. Wasn't me or my team. Please help me secure the account and restore the projects.

subject: Phishing campaign targeting our staff
body: Our staff are receiving emails that look like your notification emails ("You've been assigned a task"), but the links go to a fake login page. At least one person entered their password. We've reset it. Can you check whether that account was accessed after the phishing email? Workspace: redmoor-legal.ourapp.com

subject: Session from unknown location still active
body: My active sessions list shows a session in São Paulo that isn't mine. I clicked "Revoke", but it's still listed as active after refreshing. Is it actually revoked? Worried.
Our shared team account's password was leaked in a data breach at another site (we reused it, I know). Someone has been logging in. We've changed it. What can you tell us about the logins?

subject: Webhook added by attacker?
body: We found a webhook in our developer settings pointing to an unknown domain (collect-data.xyz) that receives all task events. None of us created it. We deleted it. We think an admin account may be compromised. How long has it been there, and what data did it receive? Org ID 71020.

subject: Compromised + want to enforce 2FA
body: One of our users was compromised last week (password reuse). We've secured her account. Now we'd like to enforce 2FA for all 40 users. How do we do that, and can you confirm her account shows no more suspicious activity? Her email: a.novak@praxis-labs.cz
Got a password changed email I didn't request. I can still log in, weirdly. Should I be worried? Changed it again just in case.

subject: Unauthorised guest access
body: An external email address we don't recognise was added as a guest to our HR project two days ago. The activity log says it was added by our HR manager, who says she didn't do it. We removed the guest. Could her account be compromised? Workspace ID ws_62117.

subject: Account takeover - need urgent help
body:
Hello,

I'm the owner of a small accounting firm's workspace. This morning I found that I've been removed as the owner, and a different account is now listed as owner and admin. I can still log in, but only as a regular member. The new owner account uses an email address I don't recognise (finance.team.acc@proton.me).

Our workspace holds sensitive client financial documents for about 80 clients. I need you to restore me as the owner, lock out the unknown account, and tell me what it accessed. This is extremely urgent.

My email: s.whitmore@whitmore-accounts.co.uk
Workspace: whitmore-accounts.ourapp.com

Sarah Whitmore
An API token was used from an IP in Russia to download our files. The token belongs to our integration account. We've revoked it. What else should we check? Org ID 28801.
send your DPA please

subject: GDPR access request
body: I'd like a copy of all personal data you hold about me under GDPR Article 15, including any data from the cookies and analytics tracking on your website. Email: d.schmidt@web.de

subject: Sub-processors in the US
body: Which of your sub-processors are in the United States, and do you rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or on SCCs for those transfers? Our DPO needs this for our transfer impact assessment.
We need your ISO 27001 certificate and the latest pentest summary for our annual supplier review. Deadline end of month.

subject: Data deletion confirmation
body: We ended our contract last month. Please confirm in writing that all our data, including backups, has been deleted, as required by our DPA (clause 11). Former org ID 42019.

subject: AI features and data use
body: Before we enable your AI features, our legal team needs to know: is our data used to train any models (yours or a third party's)? Where is it processed? Can we opt out entirely at the workspace level?
Do you have a UK GDPR addendum / IDTA for transfers from the UK? Our legal team needs it before signing.

subject: CCPA request
body: Under the CCPA, I request to know what personal information you've collected about me, and I opt out of any sale or sharing of my information. My account email is k.wilson@yahoo.com.

subject: Data processing for employee monitoring
body: Our works council has asked whether your product can be used to monitor employee performance (activity logs, login times). We need a statement on what employee data is collected and who can see it, for our works council agreement in Germany.
Please confirm that our data is encrypted at rest and in transit, and what encryption standards you use. For our security questionnaire. Org ID 90344.

subject: Right to rectification
body: My name is recorded incorrectly in your system, and I can't edit it (the field is locked by my employer's SSO). Under GDPR Article 16, I request that it be corrected to "Zofia Wiśniewska". Email: z.wisniewska@poczta.onet.pl

subject: Your LinkedIn profile
body: Hi! I noticed your company page on LinkedIn and wanted to connect. We offer outsourced software development at competitive rates. Let me know if you'd like to hear more.
Is this the bank? I need to reset my online banking PIN.
